subject: Any tips? Preparing figures for publication

messages.author: 9983e0c384950e36
messages.subject: Any tips? Preparing figures for publication
parts:
Hey all,

I'm writing up some of my data for publication, there will be ~8 figures. I'm looking for any tips that anyone might have for doing this efficiently. I want all figures to be consistent with respect to figure style, and convenience when resizing and changing labels, axes, etc.

Cheers!

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: Re: Any tips? Preparing figures for publication
parts:
Dear Aric,

Try to avoid tweaking individual figures. Use theme_set() with a custom theme and update_geom_defaults()

Best regards,

ir. Thierry Onkelinx
